plugins.description: Minimal Workspace Pane for Agent discovery and explicit local chat dock navigation.
Default starter layout that demonstrates agents, chat dock control, navigation, and toast feedback without external services.
Two Project Workspace Panes with labelled code examples and an owner-qualified review action.
Knowledge and documentation starter layout for document intake, source review, and question answering.
Starter workspace plugin that demonstrates layout tabs, chat launch, and local state.
Deterministic model-tier routing plugin with routing-decision telemetry.

Clarify an idea, review project decisions, write a specification, and approve a work breakdown using attributed pinned Skills. Tools, tracker setup, writes and publication retain the selected agent’s authority.

tools.description: Kontour Surface MCP server over the active change's trust bundle. One-click install registers a version-pinned stdio server; replace the report path placeholder with the latest Veritas reportArtifactPath.
Search the public web and retrieve pages. Hosted anonymous access is rate-limited; queries and fetched URLs go to Exa. No local runtime required.
Look up current library documentation and code examples. Hosted anonymous access is rate-limited; queries go to Context7. No local runtime required.
Search Microsoft documentation, retrieve articles and find code samples. Queries go to Microsoft Learn. No account or local runtime required.

Navigate JavaScript pages and extract content with a local headless browser. Requires a separately installed Lightpanda binary on the Station host. This is a separate session from Station’s Browser pane.
Convert documents to Markdown. Requires markitdown-mcp on the Station host; the process can read files and network locations accessible to its OS user. Optional cloud formats may require credentials.
